title: Rav Nebenzahl's Photo Controversy
body: Rav Avigdor Nebenzahl, senior posek and rov of the Old City of Yerushalayim, was photographed by Shuki Lerer on Motzoei Shabbos. A question arose about whether Rav Nebenzahl objected to being photographed before zeman Rabbeinu Tam.

title: A&B Gefilte Fish Shortage
body: A&B Famous, a top kosher food brand, halts production of its Original Gefilte Fish due to a seasonal shortage of key fish varieties. The company cited its strict adherence to traditional recipes as the reason for the temporary shortage.
